scenario: Premature Pool Release / Use-After-Release State Corruption
rely: Caller performs no writes to SessionBuf after calling p.Release(buf).
guarantee: Acquired SessionBuf remains clean (dirty == false) and exclusively owned until Release.
interleaving_trigger: G1 calls p.Release(buf); G2 calls p.Acquire('bob') and resets dirty=false; G1 then sets buf.dirty=true on G2's active session.
